about: Corner & Kettle's cup and food sheet, its style sheet as data (WISHLIST.md B1 and B2). validate.mjs reads it; cups.py reads scale, the frame sizes and the sheet. A cup layer is the old cupSvg viewBox (100 x 130) at scale pixels per unit, and every layer is that size so they stack by being drawn at one place; a food is food x scale on a side, food being the 64 px the station shows a plate at. maxKiB is KiB x 1024, maxSide the longest side in pixels. coverage bounds the share of a frame's pixels at alpha 128 or more, per class. boxTolerance is the share of the old cup's box (spec.mjs CUP_BOX) each edge of the new cup body may move by (style sheet item 1). minInk is the share of a frame's pixels at alpha 128 or more within inkTolerance of INK, for the frames drawn in INK (the cup's two halves and the foods); a tinted frame is drawn in greys instead and must be neutral to within neutralTolerance, so the multiply at draw time is the only colour it has.

colours.about: The colours the old SVG did not have, and so are decisions (style sheet item 2, #809). The glass is the old cup's white at an alpha, ice and whip and the straw are the old SVG's own fills, and the foods are new: there was no food drawing, only an emoji.
